name: io.github.vinayvobbili/taxtrace
title: taxtrace
description: Masked, read-only views of a local tax workspace: documents, form checks and to-dos. No amount, name or ID leaves your machine.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server's dependency (the taxtrace[mcp] extra)

environmentVariables.name: TAXTRACE_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Path to your tax workspace folder (documents by tax year, todo.md). Defaults to ~/TaxData. Outside any git repository.
